name: DeepCQ
subtitle: Lossy compression quality prediction
description: A modular two-stage deep-surrogate framework for predicting compression quality across compressors, metrics, and scientific datasets. The framework reuses extracted features to support configuration selection without running a full compression sweep.
people: Khondoker Mirazul Mumenin, Robert Underwood, Dong Dai, Jinzhen Wang, Sheng Di, Zarija Lukić, and Franck Cappello

name: QualityNet
subtitle: Surrogate models for compression quality
description: A surrogate-based framework for estimating compression quality metrics quickly, supporting informed choices of scientific compression configurations.
people: Khondoker Mirazul Mumenin, Dong Dai, Jinzhen Wang, and Sheng Di

name: Genesis Mission
subtitle: Phase I research
description: Our team is part of the first cohort of the DOE Genesis Mission. The award supports research at the intersection of artificial intelligence and scientific computing.
